The production code in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest` has five call sites for `UserService.getUserByUuid`. Each would see any change in its return value or null handling, so they are listed first. Test files that call it directly would also be affected, and they follow.

**Production code (best first):**
- `UserResource1_8.getByUniqueId` (line 209) returns `null` for a missing user, so a change in null behaviour changes the REST `GET /user/{uuid}` result.
- `ChangePasswordController1_8.changeOthersPassword` (line 74) throws `NullPointerException` when the lookup returns null, so any change in that return value changes the password-change endpoint.
- `ProviderSearchHandler1_9.search` (line 56) returns an empty result when the user is not found, which affects the provider search by `user` UUID.
- `UserConverter1_8.getByUniqueId` (line 36) is the converter used when a `User` is referenced by UUID in other resources.
- `AlertRecipientResource2_0.setRecipientProperty` (line 88) silently skips the recipient when the lookup returns null.

**Tests that call it directly (approximate method ranges, inferred from the method start lines):**
- `UserController1_8Test` covers create, update, retire, find, and update-password (lines 181–211, 254–276, 278–297, 317–331, 438–464).
- `UserController2_0Test` covers create, update, retire, and find (lines 78–108, 153–170, 213–232, 252–266).
- `PasswordResetController2_2Test` covers the request and reset password tests (lines 50–58, 60–70, 101–115, 117–133).
- `ChangePasswordController1_8Test.updateUser_shouldUpdateTheUserPassword` (lines 41–64).
- `UserResource2_0Test.newObject` (lines 33–39).

The UUID-lookup helpers in `AlertController2_0Test`, `AlertRecipientController2_0Test`, `AlertRecipientResource2_0Test`, `AlertResource2_0Test`, and `UserResource1_9Test` also call it. I left them out because the array is capped at 20 entries.

I did not inspect `openmrs-core` itself, so I have not confirmed what a behaviour change in `UserService.getUserByUuid` would look like. The answer relies only on the call sites in this module.
